title.zh: Brazilian Banks Expand Crypto Offerings as Regulation Takes Hold
title.en: Brazilian Banks Expand Crypto Offerings as Regulation Takes Hold

current_state.zh: Brazilian banks Itaú, Nubank, and Banco do Brasil are expanding retail crypto offerings amid a record R$505.5 billion crypto market in 2025, with banks holding no proprietary crypto.
